_comment: Step E of the taxonomy methodology (see CLAUDE.md): hand-edited interpretive names/definitions for the mechanical clusters in artefacts/taxonomy.json. Edit freely — this file NEVER feeds back into the pipeline; cmd/gentex merges it into paper/taxonomy.gen.tex at format time only. Keys are cluster ids at the current component cut; re-check them after any re-run that changes k* or the segmentation.

C31.name: root-cause-fix
C31.definition: Diagnose before editing; fix the cause, not the symptom; consult logs and tests first.

C22.name: vcs-git-safety
C22.definition: Git conventions and guardrails: never force push, no git add ., branch/commit discipline.

C78.name: edit-tool-protocol
C78.definition: Exact-string file-edit grammar (str_replace lineage): uniqueness of old_string, whitespace care.

C10.name: shell-process-mgmt
C10.definition: Managing long-running shell processes: instances, identifiers, writing to stdin, backgrounding.

C136.name: image-display-policy
C136.definition: When and how to generate or render images: carousels, product visuals, mandatory image tools.

C119.name: citation-protocol
C119.definition: Citing sources: when a citation is required, id formats, linking claims to sources.

C58.name: tool-parallelism
C58.definition: Batching independent tool calls and running them simultaneously.

C20.name: search-command-protocol
C20.definition: Efficient code search: parallel searches, rg over grep/find, dedicated search tools.

C70.name: plan-approval-flow
C70.definition: Plan mode and user approval: when to enter planning, how plans get accepted.

C29.name: audience-adaptation
C29.definition: Calibrating language to a non-technical user; plain-language and same-language rules.

C24.name: web-search-fallback
C24.definition: Escalating to public web search when internal results are insufficient; trustworthy-source rules.

C30.name: environment-self-repair
C30.definition: Missing tools or packages are installed and worked around rather than halting the task.
